subject: Procurement pulse & ops timeline for ACME — next actions
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement pulse & ops timeline for ACME — next actions

Jordan / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving without surprises.

Key points from today
- Commercial path: procurement prefers PO but payments team is open to card for initial pilot (<= $15k).
- Legal: ACME legal will do a quick redline pass; target turnaround ~7 business days.
- Security: security questionnaire (SOC2 + data residency) required; they prefer our private deployment doc if needed.
- Finance: PO issuance requires vendor setup in Coupa; typically 10 business days once legal sign-off.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached: ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx)
1) Redwood to send concise commercial summary + draft SOW (today) — owner: me
2) ACME legal to confirm redline window and primary contacts (by 2026-11-27) — owner: Jordan
3) Security questionnaire kickoff + evidence checklist (by 2026-11-24) — owner: Priya
4) Finance vendor onboarding / PO ETA (target 2026-12-10) — owner: ACME finance

Immediate asks
- Jordan: can you confirm whether procurement will accept marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace) vs direct PO? Marketplace would be fastest to get a committed contract.
- Priya: please attach the security contact and any initial SSO / data handling questions we should pre-fill.

I attached a short one-pager (Redwood_Commercial_Summary_ACME.pdf) to make legal/finance reviews faster. If it helps, Ben can join a 20-minute call with your procurement lead next week to align on PO vs card.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Commercial_Summary_ACME.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement pulse & ops timeline for ACME — next actions

Thanks Stephanie — solid recap. A few clarifications from my side: 

1) Marketplace vs PO: procurement prefers a direct PO for multi-year licensing, but ITS/fleet procurement would use Marketplace if we need a fast pilot procurement. Can you confirm what the pricing and SLA difference would be if we go marketplace for the pilot?

2) Legal timing: I can get legal to do an initial pass within 5 business days if we send the draft contract today. They will flag any vendor controls that deviate from our standard terms.

3) Security: Priya will lead; she asked whether you have a completed security pack (SOC2 + encryption overview + data flow diagram). If you can send the pack, we’ll pre-populate the questionnaire.

4) Finance: vendor setup in Coupa historically takes 7–12 business days after legal sign-off. If we get sign-off in the first week of Dec, we should expect a PO mid-December.

I’ll confirm procurement’s contact and whether they’ll accept a credit card pilot for <= $15k by Monday.

—Jordan
Director, Platform Acquisitions, ACME Corp
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acme.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement pulse & ops timeline for ACME — next actions

Appreciate the quick reply, Jordan. Answering your bullets and adding owners/timelines in-line: 

- Marketplace vs PO: Marketplace pilot would be "same tech, expedited procurement" but with a slightly different commercial flow (marketplace invoicing + fixed pilot term). Pricing parity is possible for a 3-month pilot; SLA is identical for hosted API. Ben — can you prepare a 3-month pilot pricing line for marketplace vs direct PO (three rows: pilot marketplace, pilot direct PO, enterprise PO) and share by Monday EOD?

- Contract draft: attaching the one-pager today and I’ll share a short draft SOW by EOD Monday to accelerate legal review. Jordan — please send the legal contact's email.

- Security pack: Priya, we have a security pack (SOC2 report, encryption page, data flow diagram). I’m attaching the high-level bundle and will schedule a security kickoff next Wed (2026-11-25) at 10:00 PT if that works. Can you confirm who should be on that call?

- Finance / PO: noted. To compress timeline we can: 1) supply vendor W-9 and banking info early, 2) verify cost center and invoice instructions in advance. Vivek — can you provide the vendor setup spreadsheet for ACME and a sample PO template we typically send?

Next tangible steps (owner — ETA)
- Ben: marketplace vs PO pilot pricing table — 2026-11-23
- Stephanie: draft SOW + send security pack — 2026-11-23
- Jordan: legal contact + procurement lead name — 2026-11-23
- Priya: security kickoff attendee list — 2026-11-24

If all aligns, we’re looking at: legal redline complete by 2026-11-30 -> finance onboarding first week of Dec -> PO mid-December. Will note these dates in the attached MAP.

Thanks — speak Monday if needed.

Stephanie
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Procurement pulse & ops timeline for ACME — next actions

Forwarding our thread to align internal owners. Short internal notes: 
- I’ll have the pricing table (marketplace vs PO) ready by COB Monday (2026-11-23). It will include: list price, pilot discount, marketplace add-on fee, and suggested invoice cadence.
- Vivek: can you attach the vendor setup spreadsheet (vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx) and PO template to the MAP before we send to ACME? That will reduce back-and-forth with finance.
- Karthik/Marissa: if ACME asks for a shortened SOW or pilot terms, let’s use the standard 3-month SOW template — I’ll flag the essential SLAs and data protections to keep legal review light.

Action items assigned: Ben (pricing table), Vivek (vendor onboarding docs), Stephanie (draft SOW + security pack), Karthik/Marissa (SOW guardrails).

—Ben
